title: Agencies deny Grusch access to programs

tellings.quote: went to the agencies that wrote those reports and asked for access. And when I when when they deny you access then you know it's a thing.

plain: Between about 2019 and 2022, a former US intelligence officer named David Grusch went to the agencies that had written certain reports about secret UFO programs and asked to be let in, and they refused him. Grusch tells this himself, and he says the refusal was the proof: when they deny you access, he says, you know the thing is real.
